Cursor CLI (synthetic documentation contract, not captured executable help)
Usage: agent [options] [prompt...]
Commands:
  agent [prompt...] Start in agent mode
  -p, --print
  --output-format <format>  text, json, stream-json
  --workspace <path>
  --model <model>
  -f, --force
  --trust
  -v, --version
  -h, --help
